pull.title: KAFKA-20621: Add StoredTopologyEpoch and LastFailedTopologyEpoch to StreamsGroup model and metadata record
pull.body:
Sub-task of
[KIP-1331](https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/KAFKA/KIP-1331%3A+Streams+Group+Topology+Description+Plugin)
JIRA: KAFKA-20621

This sub-task adds the broker-side  state behind those new fields and
the read/validate paths that the upcoming RPC handlers will  consume.

- `StreamsGroupMetadataValue`: two new tagged `int32` fields —
`StoredTopologyEpoch` and
  `LastFailedTopologyEpoch`, both defaulting to -1.
- `StreamsGroup`: matching `TimelineInteger` fields (initialized to -1),
with getters and a
  `committedOffset` overload for snapshot-consistent reads.
- `StreamsCoordinatorRecordHelpers.newStreamsGroupMetadataRecord`:
forwards the two new fields.
  The heartbeat epoch-bump and the fence path read them from `group` so
a routine record write
  preserves them.
- `GroupMetadataManager.replay(StreamsGroupMetadataKey, ...)`: reads
both fields.
- `StreamsGroupHeartbeatResult`: gains `currentTopologyEpoch` so the
service layer can see which
  topology epoch a heartbeat is operating at.
- `StreamsGroupDescribeResult` (new): bundles `List<DescribedGroup>`
with per-group
  `storedTopologyEpoch`. Returned by
`GroupCoordinatorShard.streamsGroupDescribe`;
  `GroupCoordinatorService` unwraps `describedGroups()` so the public
`GroupCoordinator` interface
  is unchanged.
- `GroupCoordinatorShard.validateStreamsGroupMember(groupId, memberId,
committedOffset)`
  (delegating to a matching method on `GroupMetadataManager`):
synchronous
  `GROUP_ID_NOT_FOUND` / `UNKNOWN_MEMBER_ID` check for the upcoming
  `StreamsGroupTopologyDescriptionUpdate` handler.
- Unit tests for all of the above.

Reviewers: Lucas Brutschy <lbrutschy@confluent.io>
